criteria.notes: Media program board: channel identity, playing programme, archive index, now-playing filename and elapsed/total time, across playing and source-error states.
Broadcast-continuity concept retained: full-bleed video field, small persistent identity mark, minimal chrome over picture.
Reads as a channel playout board rather than a web video player; chrome is a thin overlay, not a card.
Now-playing title and clock sit above their floors on every surface; the corrected auto-fit no longer pins them to the minimum.
Custom-theme scenario holds legible chrome over a bright picture; the default keeps white-on-dark at full strength.
Long-title scenario truncates the filename intentionally with an ellipsis while the programme index keeps its own labels bounded.
Video fills the frame at every aspect; square and portrait crop the picture with cover rather than letterboxing, and chrome stays inside the safe area.
Video renders with an explicit cover fit, so narrow surfaces crop the picture as intended; the source-error scenario substitutes a recovery reel.
Full-bleed motion with overlay chrome is distinct from the panelled and card-based examples.
